name: Elizabeth Blackmore
bio: Elizabeth Blackmore is an Australian film and television actress, best known for portraying Valerie Tulle in the television series "The Vampire Diaries". She's a graduate of the Western Australian Academy of Performing Arts at Edith Cowan University, Perth, Australia.
